title: pseudoselago ascendens
intro: Pseudoselago ascendens, commonly known as Mountain Caper or Cape Showers, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pseudoselago ascendens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Studies have also identified the presence of ursolic acid, a compound with potential anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects.
